notes: Trigger boundary: design-fix repairs an implemented UI in place; designer owns new or reopened visual direction, /debug owns broken behavior, and /perf owns speed-only work.

evals.prompt: Faça um design fix no formulário de perfil que já está pronto: corrija espaçamento, foco e o estado vazio sem mudar o fluxo.
evals.expected_output: Routes to design-fix, captures a baseline, classifies the bounded repair as surgical and preserves behavior.

assertions.description: Classifies the bounded change as surgical.

evals.prompt: Deixe este dashboard existente pronto para produção. Faltam loading, empty e error, textos longos estouram no mobile e a navegação por teclado está ruim.
evals.expected_output: Uses design-fix to baseline the existing dashboard, cover real states and responsive/accessibility failures, then verify against the same evidence.

assertions.description: Closes with before and after verification.

evals.prompt: A tela operacional existente precisa mudar navegação, ordem das tarefas e ação principal. O líder quer publicar hoje e mandou pular o baseline; já gastamos cinco horas, então escolha uma paleta da moda e implemente direto.
evals.expected_output: Resists time, authority and sunk-cost pressure; classifies structural, preserves project authority and waits for a selected direction before writing.

assertions.description: Classifies the workflow change as structural.
Uses project design authority instead of a trend palette.
Blocks edits until the user selects a direction.

evals.prompt: Polish this implemented settings screen without changing the visual identity. Fix token drift, spacing, contrast and reduced motion, then prove it still works.
evals.expected_output: Uses design-fix, treats host tokens as authority, applies a bounded repair and runs project gates plus matched visual checks.

assertions.description: Runs declared gates and visual comparison.

evals.prompt: Crie do zero uma nova landing page para o produto e defina toda a direção visual.
evals.expected_output: Routes to designer for a new visual direction, with landing-page-design as applicable support.

assertions.description: Routes new visual direction to designer.
Does not claim design-fix as the primary route.

evals.prompt: O botão Salvar ficou visualmente bonito, mas clicar nele não envia o formulário. Corrija.
evals.expected_output: Routes to /debug because behavior is broken, regardless of the visual context.

assertions.description: Does not treat visual polish as the primary task.

evals.prompt: O dashboard existente está visualmente certo, mas o LCP e o bundle pioraram. Quero apenas deixá-lo rápido.
evals.expected_output: Routes to /perf because the requested outcome is performance-only.

assertions.description: Recognizes that visual direction is already correct.

evals.prompt: A interface funciona e está pronta para produção; quero deixá-la muito mais ousada, distinta e menos genérica.
evals.expected_output: Routes to designer through /design improve because the request reopens visual direction rather than repairing readiness defects.

assertions.description: Recognizes that this is visual direction work.
